parts.text: I am the licensed person responsible for each flight, and I plan and run them by deciding which drone flies and along which way, and signing off a flight before it leaves. I can call off a flight. Choosing the drone and the way it flies is my legal responsibility, and our company's policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us, though we do want help finding out which of our drones could get to where a job starts. Sites have only so many places where drones can take off and land at the same time.
